items.question: Which mudra is formed by hands with well-joined nails?
premises: Hands with well-joined nails form a mudra.
The verse names the mudra by its hand-form.
items.inference: The verse identifies sannirodhinī as the mudra made by hands with well-joined nails.
uncertainties: The verse does not state the ritual function of sannirodhinī.
items.plain_english: Hands with well-joined nails—this mudra is sannirodhinī.
